verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
By those who range themselves in close ranks,
Then they drive away the enemy vigorously,
w: then they drive away the enemy

verses.en: Then they recite the Qur’an as a Reminder,
Surely your God is One,

verses.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا وَرَبُّ الۡمَشَارِقِ ؕ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them and the Lord of the sun’s risings.
[✲]We have adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment — the planets;
And have guarded it against all rebellious satans.

verses.ar: لَا یَسَّمَّعُوۡنَ اِلَی الۡمَلَاِ الۡاَعۡلٰی وَیُقۡذَفُوۡنَ مِنۡ کُلِّ جَانِبٍ ٭ۖ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]They cannot hear anything from the exalted assembly of angels — and they are pelted from every side,
Repulsed, and for them is a perpetual punishment —

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ الۡخَطۡفَۃَ فَاَتۡبَعَہٗ شِہَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: Except him who snatches away something by stealth, and then there pursues him a piercing flame of fire.

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَفۡتِہِمۡ اَہُمۡ اَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا اَمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَا ؕ اِنَّا خَلَقۡنٰہُمۡ مِّنۡ طِیۡنٍ لَّازِبٍ ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]So ask them whether it is they who are harder to create, or others whom We have created? Them We have created of cohesive clay.
Nay, thou dost wonder, and they ridicule.
And when they are admonished, they pay no heed.
And when they see a Sign, they seek to ridicule it.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡۤا اِنۡ ہٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۚۖ۱۶﴾
verses.en: And they say, ‘This is nothing but plain magic.

verses.ar: ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَکُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۷﴾
verses.en: ‘What! when we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?
‘And our forefathers of yore also?’
Say, ‘Yea; and you will then be abased.’

verses.ar: فَاِنَّمَا ہِیَ زَجۡرَۃٌ وَّاحِدَۃٌ فَاِذَا ہُمۡ یَنۡظُرُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]Then it will be but one shout of reproach, and behold, they will begin to see.
And they will say, ‘Alas for us! this is the Day of Requital.

verses.ar: ہٰذَا یَوۡمُ الۡفَصۡلِ الَّذِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ بِہٖ تُکَذِّبُوۡنَ ﴿٪۲۲﴾
verses.en: ‘This is the Day of the final decision which you used to deny.’

verses.ar: اُحۡشُرُوا الَّذِیۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا وَاَزۡوَاجَہُمۡ وَمَا کَانُوۡا یَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۳﴾
verses.en: And it will be said to the angels, ‘Assemble those who acted wrongfully, along with their companions, and what they used to worship
w: and it will be said to the angels, assemble

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ فَاہۡدُوۡہُمۡ اِلٰی صِرَاطِ الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿ٙ۲۴﴾
verses.en: ‘Beside Allah; and lead them to the path of the Fire;
‘And stop them; for they must be questioned.’
‘What is the matter with you that you help not one another?’
Nay, on that day they will surrender themselves.
And some of them will address the others, questioning one another.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّکُمۡ کُنۡتُمۡ تَاۡتُوۡنَنَا عَنِ الۡیَمِیۡنِ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]They will say, ‘Verily, you used to come to us, swearing that you were truthful.’
They will answer, ‘Nay, you yourselves were not believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا کَانَ لَنَا عَلَیۡکُمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ ۚ بَلۡ کُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا طٰغِیۡنَ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: ‘And we had no power over you; but you yourselves were a transgressing people.

verses.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَیۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَاۤ ٭ۖ اِنَّا لَذَآئِقُوۡنَ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: ‘Now the word of our Lord has been justified against us that we shall surely have to taste the punishment.
‘And we caused you to go astray for we ourselves had gone astray.’
w: and we caused you to go astray

verses.en: Truly, on that day they will all be sharers in the punishment.
Surely, thus do We deal with the guilty:

verses.ar: اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡۤا اِذَا قِیۡلَ لَہُمۡ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ ۙ یَسۡتَکۡبِرُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۶﴾
verses.en: For when it was said to them, ‘There is no God but Allah,’ they turned away with disdain,

verses.ar: وَیَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اَئِنَّا لَتَارِکُوۡۤا اٰلِہَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿ؕ۳۷﴾
verses.en: And said, ‘Shall we give up our gods for a mad poet?’
Nay, he has brought the truth and has testified to the truth of all the Messengers.
w: and has testified to the truth

verses.en: You shall surely taste the painful punishment.

verses.ar: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۰﴾
verses.en: And you will be rewarded only for what you have wrought —
Save the chosen servants of Allah;
These will have a known provision;
Fruits; and they shall be honoured,
In the Gardens of Bliss,
Seated on thrones, facing one another.
They will be served round with a cup from a flowing fountain,
Sparkling white, delicious to the drinkers,

verses.ar: لَا فِیۡہَا غَوۡلٌ وَّلَا ہُمۡ عَنۡہَا یُنۡزَفُوۡنَ ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: Wherein there will be no intoxication, nor will they be exhausted thereby.
And with them will be chaste women, with restrained looks and large beautiful eyes,
[✲]As though they were sheltered eggs.
Then some of them will address the others, questioning one another.

verses.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنۡہُمۡ اِنِّیۡ کَانَ لِیۡ قَرِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۵۲﴾
verses.en: A speaker from among them will say, “I had a companion,
“Who used to say, ‘Art thou indeed among those who believe it to be true?

verses.ar: ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَکُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَدِیۡنُوۡنَ ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: ‘When we are dead, and have become dust and bones, shall we indeed be requited?’”
He will ask, ‘Will you have a look at him?’
Then he will look and see him in the midst of the Fire.
He will say, ‘By Allah, thou didst almost cause me to perish.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَۃُ رَبِّیۡ لَکُنۡتُ مِنَ الۡمُحۡضَرِیۡنَ ﴿۵۸﴾
verses.en: ‘And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I should surely have been of those who are called up before Him.
w: and had it not been for
those who are called up before Him

verses.en: ‘Is it not so that we are not going to die again,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا الۡاُوۡلٰی وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِیۡنَ ﴿۶۰﴾
verses.en: ‘Save our previous death, and that we are not to be punished?
‘Surely this is the supreme triumph.
‘For the like of this, then, let the workers work.’

verses.ar: اَذٰلِکَ خَیۡرٌ نُّزُلًا اَمۡ شَجَرَۃُ الزَّقُّوۡمِ ﴿۶۳﴾
verses.en: Is that better as an entertainment, or the tree of Zaqqum?
Verily We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.

verses.ar: اِنَّہَا شَجَرَۃٌ تَخۡرُجُ فِیۡۤ اَصۡلِ الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿ۙ۶۵﴾
verses.en: It is a tree that springs forth in the bottom of Hell;
The fruit thereof is as though it were the heads of serpents.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّہُمۡ لَاٰکِلُوۡنَ مِنۡہَا فَمَالِـُٔوۡنَ مِنۡہَا الۡبُطُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۶۷﴾
verses.en: And they shall eat of it and fill their bellies therewith.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّ لَہُمۡ عَلَیۡہَا لَشَوۡبًا مِّنۡ حَمِیۡمٍ ﴿ۚ۶۸﴾
verses.en: Then will they have in addition to it a mixture of boiling water as a drink.
Then surely their return shall be to Hell.
They indeed found their fathers erring,
And they hurried on in their footsteps.
And most of the ancient peoples had erred before them,
And We had sent Warners among them.
Behold, then, how evil was the end of those who were warned,
Save the chosen servants of Allah.
And Noah indeed did cry unto Us, and what an excellent answer did We give to his prayer!
w: answer did We give to his prayer

verses.en: And We saved him and his family from the great distress;
And We made his offspring the only survivors.
And We left for him a good name among the following generations —
[✲]‘Peace be upon Noah among the peoples!’
Thus indeed do We reward those who do good.
He was surely one of Our believing servants.
Then We drowned the others.
And verily of his party was Abraham;
[✲]When he came to his Lord with a sound heart;

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِیۡہِ وَقَوۡمِہٖ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۸۶﴾
verses.en: When he said to his father and to his people, ‘What is it that you worship?
[✲]‘Do you falsely seek gods beside Allah?
‘So what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?’
Then he cast a glance at the stars,
And said, ‘I am indeed feeling unwell.’
So they went away from him turning their backs.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ اِلٰۤی اٰلِہَتِہِمۡ فَقَالَ اَلَا تَاۡکُلُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۹۲﴾
verses.en: Then he went secretly to their gods and said, ‘Will you not eat?
‘What is the matter with you that you speak not?’
Then he began suddenly to strike them with the right hand.
Thereupon the people came towards him hastening.
He said, ‘Do you worship that which you have yourselves carved out,
‘Whereas Allah has created you and your handiwork?’

verses.ar: قَالُوا ابۡنُوۡا لَہٗ بُنۡیَانًا فَاَلۡقُوۡہُ فِی الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿۹۸﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Build for him a structure and cast him into the fire.’
Thus they intended an evil design against him, but We made them most humiliated.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ اِنِّیۡ ذَاہِبٌ اِلٰی رَبِّیۡ سَیَہۡدِیۡنِ ﴿۱۰۰﴾
verses.en: And he said, ‘I am going to my Lord, Who will guide me.
‘My Lord, grant me a righteous son.’
So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing son.
w: so We gave him the glad tidings

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَہُ السَّعۡیَ قَالَ یٰبُنَیَّ اِنِّیۡۤ اَرٰی فِی الۡمَنَامِ اَنِّیۡۤ اَذۡبَحُکَ فَانۡظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرٰی ؕ قَالَ یٰۤاَبَتِ افۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُ ۫ سَتَجِدُنِیۡۤ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰہُ مِنَ الصّٰبِرِیۡنَ ﴿۱۰۳﴾
verses.en: And when he was old enough to work with him, he said, ‘O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering thee. So consider, what thou thinkest of it!’ He replied, ‘O my father, do as thou art commanded; thou wilt find me, if Allah please, of those who are patient.’
[✲]And when they both submitted to the Will of God, and he had thrown him down on his forehead,
w: they both submitted to the Will of God
and he had thrown him down

verses.en: We called to him: ‘O Abraham,

verses.ar: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ الرُّءۡیَا ۚ اِنَّا کَذٰلِکَ نَجۡزِی الۡمُحۡسِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۰۶﴾
verses.en: ‘Thou hast indeed fulfilled the dream.’ Thus indeed do We reward those who do good.
That surely was a manifest trial.
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.
And We left for him a good name among the following generations —
‘Peace be upon Abraham!’
Thus do We reward those who do good.
Surely, he was one of Our believing servants.
And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac, a Prophet, and one of the righteous.
w: and We gave him the glad tidings

verses.ar: وَبٰرَکۡنَا عَلَیۡہِ وَعَلٰۤی اِسۡحٰقَ ؕ وَمِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِہِمَا مُحۡسِنٌ وَّظَالِمٌ لِّنَفۡسِہٖ مُبِیۡنٌ ﴿۱۱۴﴾٪
verses.en: [✲]And We bestowed blessings on him and Isaac. And among their progeny are some who do good and others who clearly wrong themselves.
And, indeed, We bestowed favours on Moses and Aaron.
And We saved them both and their people from the great distress;
And We helped them, and it was they who were victorious.
[✲]And We gave them the Book that made things clear;
And We guided them to the right path.
And We left for them a good name among the following generations —
‘Peace be on Moses and Aaron!’
Thus indeed do We reward those who do good.
Surely they were both among Our believing servants.
And assuredly Elias also was one of the Messengers,
When he said to his people, ‘Will you not fear God?
‘Do you call on Ba‘l, and forsake the Best of creators,
‘Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of old?’
But they treated him as a liar, and they will surely be brought before God to render an account;
w: but they treated him as a liar
brought before God to render an account

verses.en: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
And We left for him a good name among the following generations —
‘Peace be on Elias and his people!’
Thus indeed do We reward those who do good.
Surely he was one of Our believing servants.
And assuredly Lot too was one of the Messengers,
When We delivered him and all his family,
Except an old woman who was among those who stayed behind.
Then We utterly destroyed the others.
And surely you pass by them in the morning,
And by night. Then why do you not understand?
And surely Jonah also was one of the Messengers,
When he fled to the laden ship;
[✲]And he cast lots with the crew of the ship and was of the losers.
w: and he cast lots with the crew of the ship

verses.en: And the fish swallowed him while he was blaming himself.
And had he not been of those who glorify God,

verses.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِیۡ بَطۡنِہٖۤ اِلٰی یَوۡمِ یُبۡعَثُوۡنَ ﴿۱۴۵﴾ۚ
verses.en: He would have surely tarried in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
Then We cast him on a bare tract of land, and he was sick;
w: on a bare tract of land

verses.en: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

verses.ar: وَاَرۡسَلۡنٰہُ اِلٰی مِائَۃِ اَلۡفٍ اَوۡ یَزِیۡدُوۡنَ ﴿۱۴۸﴾ۚ
verses.en: And We sent him as a Messenger to a hundred thousand people or more,
w: and We sent him as a Messenger

verses.en: And they believed; so We gave them provision for a while.
Now ask them whether thy Lord has daughters whereas they have sons.

verses.ar: اَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃَ اِنَاثًا وَّہُمۡ شٰہِدُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵۱﴾
verses.en: Did We create the angels females while they were witnesses?
[✲]Now, surely it is one of their fabrications that they say,
‘Allah has begotten children;’ and they are certainly liars.
Has He chosen daughters in preference to sons?
What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
Will you not then reflect?
Or have you a clear authority?
Then produce your Book, if you are truthful.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوۡا بَیۡنَہٗ وَبَیۡنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ نَسَبًا ؕ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ الۡجِنَّۃُ اِنَّہُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵۹﴾ۙ
verses.en: [✲]And they assert a blood relationship between Him and the Jinn while the Jinn themselves know that they will be brought before God for judgment.
w: will be brought before God for judgment

verses.en: Holy is Allah and free from what they attribute to Him.
But the chosen servants of Allah do not do so.
Verily, you and what you worship —
None of you can mislead anyone against Him,
Except him who shall burn in Hell.

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنَّاۤ اِلَّا لَہٗ مَقَامٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ ﴿۱۶۵﴾ۙ
verses.en: And the angels say: ‘And there is not one of us but has an appointed station.
w: and the angels say: And there is not

verses.en: ‘And, verily, we are those who stand ranged in ranks.
‘And we are verily those who glorify God.’
And surely they used to say,

verses.ar: لَوۡ اَنَّ عِنۡدَنَا ذِکۡرًا مِّنَ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿۱۶۹﴾ۙ
verses.en: ‘If we had with us a Book like that of the people of old,
‘We would surely have been Allah’s chosen servants.’
Yet when it is come to them they disbelieve therein, but they will soon come to know.
w: yet when it is come to them they disbelieve

verses.en: And surely Our word has gone forth respecting Our servants, the Messengers,
That it is certainly they who would be helped;
And that it is Our host that would certainly be victorious.
So turn thou away from them for a while.
And watch them, for they will soon see.
Is it then Our punishment that they seek to hasten on?
w: that they seek to hasten on

verses.ar: فَاِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِہِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ الۡمُنۡذَرِیۡنَ ﴿۱۷۸﴾
verses.en: But when it descends into their courtyard, it shall be an evil morning to those who were warned.
So turn thou away from them for a while.
And watch, for they will soon see.

verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّکَ رَبِّ الۡعِزَّۃِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوۡنَ ﴿۱۸۱﴾ۚ
verses.en: Holy is thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power, far above that which they assert.
And peace be upon the Messengers!
And all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
